title: 70% of Inheritances Vanish in One Generation
hook: Seventy percent of inherited wealth is completely gone within one generation — and it has nothing to do with taxes.
angle: The psychology of unearned wealth: heirs don't inherit the habits that built the money, so the money disappears. Generational wealth isn't about the amount — it's about the mindset.
audience: Anyone expecting an inheritance, building wealth for their kids, or curious why wealthy families go broke
key_numbers: Only 3 in 10 family fortunes survive the first handoff
